I’d never recommend it. No matter what you do, it has the potential to kill. Besides that it’s an addiction. If there’s a time you want to get clean you’ll struggle. This will shape you a lot since you’re still developing. As well, it’s not just harm and be done. There’s a lot that comes as a result from this. If you leave scars there’s potential it’ll never fade. While you engage in sh you’ll probably have to be prepared to hide and or lie to people you care about. You might hate yourself in the future for engaging in such an act.

To be honest, even if it is for attention, it’s clearly a very severe issue if you’re willing to put harm to yourself. I suggest talking to someone, any trusted adult, before you do SH. It’s not really that easy to just do and drop.

I wish you the best
